parent_objective: design selected-checkpoint measured execution for guarded-v2 repair outcome localization
blocked_by: M2305 routes clean but below-floor M2304 training evidence to measured outcome design instead of another training run
supersedes: interpreting M2304 candidate return as repair success
direct measured execution without design freeze
another guarded repair training run before outcome evidence

public_gates: M2306 must not run measured execution
M2306 must use M2304 selected_checkpoint_rows.csv and config root
M2306 must preserve the M2293 72 scenario specs x 15 selected checkpoints = 1080 episode shape
M2306 must use M2293/M2295/M2298 as reference artifacts for audit planning only
M2306 must freeze a bounded follow-up execution command or route to synthesis
M2306 must not rank profiles, select a winner, promote a checkpoint, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes the measured outcome route needed to test whether M2304 guarded-v2 selected checkpoints affect M2298 offtrack/collision slices
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: measured-execution design only; no execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2304 selected checkpoint rows are missing
stop if M2293 scenario-task-family runner cannot consume M2304 selected rows
stop if the design would change scenario specs or actor inputs
stop if no bounded execution command can be frozen
fallback_plan: route to artifact repair if M2304 selected rows or configs are malformed
route to execution if a clean frozen command is available
route to branch synthesis if measured execution is not justified after below-floor training
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2305 routes guarded-v2 repair evidence to selected-checkpoint measured execution design

admission_evidence: M2305 blocks another training run before measured outcome evidence
M2293 provides the reusable scenario-task-family measured execution shape
allowed_updates: M2306 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up measured-execution manifest if admitted
next_stage_criteria: M2307 command is frozen or branch synthesis is selected
expected scenario spec count selected checkpoint count and episode count are stated
guardrails and claim boundaries are stated

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2306 designs measured execution only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2306.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2304 selected checkpoint rows and M2293 scenario-task-family measured execution protocol.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the design cannot preserve the M2293 measured panel shape, route to synthesis rather than lowering evidence standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: can admit a measured outcome panel instead of another local training repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can enable the first post-guarded-v2 outcome comparison against M2293/M2298 slices
must_synthesize_if: M2306 cannot freeze an execution command
M2306 proposes another training run before measured outcome evidence
M2306 would rank profiles or claim repair success from selected returns

hypothesis: A bounded measured-execution design can test whether M2304 guarded-v2 selected checkpoints change the M2293 scenario-task-family outcome distribution and M2298 offtrack/collision slices.
success_criteria: M2304 selected checkpoint rows and config root are named
M2293 scenario config and measured runner are named
one follow-up execution manifest is pre-registered or synthesis route is selected
ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: M2306 changes scenario specs or actor inputs
M2306 ignores the M2304 selected checkpoint rows
M2306 admits ranking or winner selection
M2306 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2306 cannot select a next route

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design of guarded-v2 selected-checkpoint measured execution over M2304 selected checkpoints

decision_rule: M2306 passes if it freezes a bounded measured-execution design over M2304 selected checkpoints or selects a synthesis route while keeping all ranking and paper claims blocked.
